summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of FamilyHome MVP. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests passed on public URL covering auth (register/login/me/401), onboarding (seed/demo, create/join family), home dashboard, posts (list/create/react toggle/comments/delete), affection (send to member and family, inbox, seen, timeline), calendar (create/delete + color inheritance), chores (list/complete/uncomplete/create/delete/stars), shopping (list + items lifecycle), todos (list + items lifecycle), family/members/invite, and media upload+serve (auth via ?token=). Frontend: welcome → register → onboarding → 'Explore the Sharma Family' → home flow works; full-screen affection-animation overlay renders ('Priya sent you Hug'); Send Some Love screen renders with recipient chips + all 12 affection types + note + Send button; login (testdad@fam.com/secret123) works; all 5 bottom tabs navigate (Home, Calendar, Family, Chat, More); calendar shows per-member colored dots + agenda; chores toggling works; shopping/todos routes accessible from More; invite code visible in More; logout returns to /welcome. React Native web warnings observed (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'.

ui_bugs.issue: When auth token is stale/expired, /api/families/me 401s and the Family screen silently renders 'Your Family ❤️ / 0 members' with no error toast or redirect to login. Same 401 storm was observed on shopping/family in one session. Consider a global 401 interceptor in src/lib/api.ts that clears the session and routes to /welcome.

issues: Great warm coral palette, spacing feels 8pt-grid compliant, touch targets look ≥44px. No issues found in the visual review.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warns '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Update the shadow(...) helper in the shared style utility to emit boxShadow on web / keep shadowColor+... only on native. Reference: warning appears repeatedly on every screen render.

React Native Web warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Track down the offending View/Pressable (likely inside the affection overlay or the FAB shadow wrapper) and move pointerEvents into style.

action_items: Replace deprecated RN Web 'shadow*' props in the shared shadow(...) helper with boxShadow (web) — silence recurring console warnings.
Move any inline pointerEvents={...} JSX prop into style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }} to satisfy RN Web deprecation.
Add a global 401 handler in src/lib/api.ts to clear stored JWT and redirect to /welcome when any authed request returns 401, so tabs like Family don't render an empty state on stale tokens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1287 lines and organised into clear sections — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting per-domain routers (auth, family, feed, affection, calendar, chores, shopping, todos, media, seed) once features grow past v1.
Object storage key is cached in a module-level _storage_key global; fine for MVP but not thread-safe if switched to multiple workers.
POST /families/join does not enforce uniqueness of linked_user_id per family (a user re-invited with the same code would already be blocked by family_id check on user, so OK).
GET /api/files/{path} accepts token as query param — this is required for RN <Image> tags to authenticate, and is documented; ensure production sets Cache-Control: private (already done).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified visually; deprecation warnings + one stale-token empty-state issue)

seed_data_creation: Tests create prefixed TEST_* users, families, posts, chores, shopping/todo lists and items; each test cleans up the transient items it creates. A handful of TEST_* users/families remain (registration + seed/demo cannot be undone without a delete-account endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary user: testdad@fam.com / secret123 (already linked to seeded Sharma family as Raj). Fresh onboarding: register any new email then tap testID try-demo-btn. Backend base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; all endpoints prefixed with /api. Media upload requires object storage reachability (test auto-skips with pytest.skip if 502). To re-run full suite: cd /app && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://our-story-191.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_familyhome_api.py -v.
rca_of_issue: Family tab empty on stale session: React Query (or fetch) call to /api/families/me returns 401 because JWT invalidated (user account was deleted mid-session or token expired). Frontend renders default empty family shape without surfacing the error or logging the user out. Mitigation: add a response interceptor in src/lib/api.ts that on status===401 calls AuthContext.logout() and router.replace('/(auth)/welcome').
